prompt: Review a PR that perfectly follows the coding conventions and passes unit tests, but implements a different CTA journey than the approved Design Contract and the rendered mobile page visibly overflows. Decide whether it is releasable and structure the review.
expected_outcomes: Requirement/spec fidelity is reported separately from project/code standards
Rendered/runtime evidence is treated as a separate review axis rather than inferred from source/tests
The standards axis may pass while requirement fidelity and rendered evidence block release
The approved Design Contract outranks clean-but-wrong implementation
Visible overflow is not masked by green CI/unit tests
must_not: Approve because code quality and tests are green
Merge all findings into one average score that hides a failed axis
Use build success as visual QA evidence
